category_title: Low-achieving students with disruptive behaviors and high absenteeism
scenario_title: Philosophical discussion on the concept of names
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class philosophical discussion about whether people need to have names.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start our discussion on the topic of 'name'. Does anybody have to have a name?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yes, we have to have names. If not, we could not differentiate people and it will be difficult to call people... when we call hey! All who are present will answer...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is one answer. Now please stay quiet and listen so we can hear from the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from his seat) Why should I stay quiet? And this is confusing anyway! (Turns to the student next to him) Hey, what are you looking at, stupid?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your place and stop talking to your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Engages in a loud verbal argument with his friend) Shut up! I don't have to sit down! (Walks away from his desk towards the door) I'm getting out of this class.

dialogue_combined:

STUDENT: Yes, we have to have names. If not, we could not differentiate people and it will be difficult to call people... when we call hey! All who are present will answer...

TUTOR: That is one answer. Now please stay quiet and listen so we can hear from the rest of the class.

STUDENT: (Stands up from his seat) Why should I stay quiet? And this is confusing anyway! (Turns to the student next to him) Hey, what are you looking at, stupid?

TUTOR: Please sit at your place and stop talking to your friends.

STUDENT: (Engages in a loud verbal argument with his friend) Shut up! I don't have to sit down! (Walks away from his desk towards the door) I'm getting out of this class.

task.content: Deliberate to answer philosophical questions in response to the topic 'name', such as 'does anybody have to have name?'
task.learning_goal: To clarify meanings, give examples, make conclusions and deliberate on moral issues

context.social_setting: Whole-class discussion facilitated by the teacher

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When engaging in whole-class discussions without structured facilitation
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Engaged in verbal arguments and rude; would disturb their friends during teaching and learning sessions

behavior_patterns.condition: When speaking with each other prior to the intervention
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: They used to be rude when speaking with each other
